sentences.en: At times of crisis, people put all their disagreements aside.
sentences.zh: 在危机时刻，人们会把所有的分歧搁置一旁。

sentences.en: There was disagreement between Sami and Layla about the dogs.
sentences.zh: 萨米和莱拉对狗的问题存在意见不合。

sentences.en: The chairman did not rule out the possibility of a disagreement.
sentences.zh: 主席没有排除出现分歧的可能性。

senses.zh: 分歧，意见不合,异议，争论,不一致,不适合
